question: How normal is your boyfriend about you?

answers.label: Extremely normal. Obviously.
answers.reply: Yes. Very normal. Just made an entire website about you. Casual.

answers.label: A little bit obsessed.
answers.reply: “A little” is doing a lot of work in that sentence, pretty lady.

answers.label: President of my fan club.
answers.reply: Founder, president, and the guy in the front row cheering too loudly.

question: Pick our perfect kind of day.

answers.label: A tiny adventure, just us.
answers.reply: Getting a little lost with you sounds like a very good plan.

answers.label: Snacks. A blanket. Zero plans.
answers.reply: Excellent itinerary. I will be stealing your snacks, though.

answers.label: Literally anything together.
answers.reply: That’s the thing, isn’t it? You make ordinary days feel like something.

answers.label: Will you still choose me on my grumpy days?
answers.reply: The grumpy days. The tired days. The “don’t talk to me” days. Still you.

answers.label: Can I keep being your favourite?
answers.reply: Position permanently filled. No further applications will be accepted.

answers.label: Are you going to get all mushy now?
answers.reply: Too late. I’ve been mushy since the first page.
